summary: HPS Corporate Capital Solutions Fund, a non-traded BDC, filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 671,158 common shares for $18.31 million total consideration, with the $27.29 per-share purchase price (matching August 31, 2026 NAV) finalized September 22, 2026 for shares sold September 1, 2026 under subscription agreements, exempt via Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D or S. The Fund also declared regular monthly distributions of $0.1390 per share plus a $0.125 special distribution, both payable September 30, 2026. Aggregate NAV was $1,391.1 million; portfolio fair value $2,216.7 million; debt $835.6 million. This is routine continuous-offering activity, not a special situation.
